name: AI Observability Dashboard
description: AI-powered predictive monitoring and anomaly detection

nrql.query: SELECT count(*) FROM AnomalyDetectionEvent TIMESERIES 15 minutes SINCE 6 hours ago
SELECT average(mlPredictionAccuracy) FROM MlPredictionAccuracy TIMESERIES 1 hour SINCE 24 hours ago
SELECT average(riskScore) FROM IncidentPredictionEvent TIMESERIES 15 minutes SINCE 6 hours ago
SELECT count(*) FROM AnomalyDetectionEvent FACET severity SINCE 24 hours ago
SELECT count(*) FROM IncidentPredictionEvent FACET riskLevel SINCE 24 hours ago
SELECT average(accuracy) FROM ModelPerformance FACET modelType SINCE 24 hours ago
SELECT average(prediction) FROM PredictiveMetricEvent FACET metricName TIMESERIES 30 minutes SINCE 6 hours ago
SELECT metricName, anomalyScore, severity, detectionMethod, timestamp FROM AnomalyDetectionEvent ORDER BY timestamp DESC LIMIT 20
SELECT serviceName, resourceType, currentUsage, predictedPeak, growthRate FROM CapacityPlanningEvent ORDER BY predictedPeak DESC LIMIT 10
SELECT incidentId, potentialCause, confidence, impactLevel FROM RootCauseAnalysisEvent ORDER BY confidence DESC LIMIT 10
SELECT recommendationType, message, priority, timestamp FROM AIRecommendationEvent ORDER BY timestamp DESC LIMIT 15
